facts.fact: Comores Infos reports that the startup Komor-IA, founded in August 2025 by Soilahoudine Mohamed Ali, is developing three AI projects: Press-IA, Agro-IA (plant disease detection) and Health-IA (a breast-cancer diagnosis prototype claimed at 85% precision).
